source: ACC01 v2.0, 2026-01-08, hierarchy tables on PDF pages 25-34

BS/NA/PPE/LAND.name: LAND
BS/NA/PPE/LAND.definition: The ground and soil owned by the company, often held as a long-term asset.
BS/NA/PPE/LAND.exclusions: Exclude investment land and land held for resale.

BS/NA/PPE/BLDG.name: BUILDINGS
BS/NA/PPE/BLDG.definition: Structures such as oﬃces, factories, or warehouses owned by the business.

BS/NA/PPE/INDB.name: INDUSTRY BUILDINGS
BS/NA/PPE/INDB.definition: Buildings speciﬁcally used for industrial or manufacturing purposes.

BS/NA/PPE/OFFB.name: OFFICE BUILDINGS
BS/NA/PPE/OFFB.definition: Buildings primarily used for administrative and oﬃce activities.

BS/NA/PPE/PLNT.name: PLANT
BS/NA/PPE/PLNT.definition: Industrial facilities and installations used in production processes.

BS/NA/PPE/MCHN.name: MACHINERY
BS/NA/PPE/MCHN.definition: Machines used in manufacturing or operational activities.

BS/NA/PPE/HVYE.name: HEAVY EQUIPMENT
BS/NA/PPE/HVYE.definition: Large equipment such as cranes, bulldozers, or industrial movers.

BS/NA/PPE/MTVE.name: MOTOR VEHICLES
BS/NA/PPE/MTVE.definition: Company-owned cars, trucks, and other transport vehicles.
BS/NA/PPE/MTVE.exclusions: Exclude fuel, rental and vehicles for resale.

BS/NA/PPE/FNFT.name: FURNITURE & FITTING
BS/NA/PPE/FNFT.definition: Oﬃce furniture, ﬁxtures, and interior ﬁttings.

BS/NA/PPE/OFFE.name: OFFICE EQUIPMENT
BS/NA/PPE/OFFE.definition: Equipment used in oﬃces, such as printers, copiers, and telephones.

BS/NA/PPE/COMP.name: COMPUTER
BS/NA/PPE/COMP.definition: Desktop, laptop, and server hardware owned by the company.
BS/NA/PPE/COMP.exclusions: Exclude hardware bought for resale and subscriptions.
BS/NA/PPE/COMP.purpose: Computer hardware held for business use

BS/NA/PPE/SOFT.name: SOFTWARE
BS/NA/PPE/SOFT.exclusions: Exclude recurring SaaS access and support; capitalisation requires review.
BS/NA/PPE/SOFT.purpose: Software meeting the company asset recognition policy

BS/NA/PPE/RENO.name: RENOVATION
BS/NA/PPE/RENO.definition: Capitalized costs related to improving or upgrading existing assets.

BS/NA/IVM/ILND.name: LAND
BS/NA/IVM/ILND.definition: Land held as a long-term investment, not for operational use.
BS/NA/IVM/ILND.exclusions: Exclude operational land and developer trading stock.
BS/NA/IVM/ILND.purpose: Land held for investment rather than operational use

BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.name: BUILDINGS
BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.definition: Properties held for rental income, capital appreciation, or future sale.
BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.exclusions: Exclude owner-occupied buildings and property trading stock.
BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.purpose: Property held for rental income or appreciation

BS/NA/IVM/IQTS.name: QUOTED SHARES
BS/NA/IVM/IQTS.definition: Shares of publicly listed companies traded on a stock exchange.

BS/NA/IVM/IUTS.name: UNQUOTED SHARES
BS/NA/IVM/IUTS.definition: Shares in private companies not listed on any public stock exchange.

BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.name: TRADING STOCKS
BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.definition: Finished goods held for resale in the ordinary course of business.
BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.exclusions: Exclude office equipment used by the company.
BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.purpose: Goods held for resale in ordinary business

BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.name: CONSUMABLE STOCK
BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.definition: Materials and supplies used in operations but not intended for resale.
BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.exclusions: Exclude already consumed expenses; follow inventory policy.
BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.purpose: Materials and supplies held for operational consumption

BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.name: TRADE DEBTORS
BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.definition: Amounts owed by customers from credit sales of goods or services.
BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.exclusions: Exclude supplier advances and customer deposits received.
BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.purpose: Customer amounts due from ordinary credit sales

BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.name: TRADE DEPOSIT PAYABLES
BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.definition: Deposits paid to suppliers as security or advance against future purchases.
BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.exclusions: Exclude unpaid supplier balances and customer advances received; PDF label is ambiguous, use payment direction.
BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.purpose: Trade deposits paid to suppliers for future purchases

BS/CA/ORV/OTDB.name: OTHER DEBTORS
BS/CA/ORV/OTDB.definition: Non-trade amounts receivable from parties not related to core operations.

BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.name: OTHER DEPOSIT RECEIVABLES
BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.definition: Refundable deposits held from employees, tenants, or other third parties.
BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.exclusions: Exclude deposits received; PDF wording conflicts with asset classification, require review.
BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.purpose: Refundable security deposits paid by the company

BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.name: PREPAYMENT
BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.definition: Payments made in advance for goods or services to be received in future.
usage_examples: Annual insurance paid before coverage is consumed
BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.exclusions: Exclude refundable security deposits and already consumed services; a billing period alone does not prove prepayment.
BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.purpose: Advance payments for future goods or service coverage

BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.name: OTHER RECEIVABLES (DIRECTOR ACCOUNT)
BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.definition: Amounts receivable from or payable to company directors (non-trade).
BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.exclusions: Amounts owed to directors use OPDC instead.
BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.purpose: Non-trade amounts owed to the company by directors

BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.name: CURRENT YEAR TAX PAID
BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.definition: Tax payments made during the current ﬁscal year that exceed the liability, recoverable as an asset.
BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.exclusions: Not supplier SST input tax; distinguish tax expense and tax payable.
BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.purpose: Current-year income tax payments recoverable or offset against tax liability

BS/CA/CTX/PYPX.name: PREVIOUS YEAR TAX OVER PAID
BS/CA/CTX/PYPX.definition: Overpaid taxes from prior years that are recoverable from tax authorities.
BS/CA/CTX/PYPX.purpose: Recoverable overpayment of prior-year income tax

BS/CA/CNB/BANK.name: CASH AT BANK
BS/CA/CNB/BANK.definition: Funds held in checking, savings, or other bank accounts.
BS/CA/CNB/BANK.exclusions: Exclude overdraft liabilities; do not assume payment from invoice bank details.
BS/CA/CNB/BANK.purpose: Balances and movements in company bank accounts

BS/CA/CNB/CASH.name: CASH ON HAND
BS/CA/CNB/CASH.definition: Physical currency and coins held by the business.
BS/CA/CNB/CASH.purpose: Physical cash held by the business

BS/EQ/CAP/SHCP.name: SHARE CAPITAL
BS/EQ/CAP/SHCP.definition: Capital contributed by shareholders through the issuance of shares.

BS/EQ/CAP/POCP.name: PROPRIETOR CAPITAL
BS/EQ/CAP/POCP.definition: Capital invested by the sole owner of a proprietorship business.
BS/EQ/CAP/POCP.exclusions: Exclude owner loans where separately accounted.

BS/EQ/CAP/PTCP.name: PARTNERSHIP CAPITAL
BS/EQ/CAP/PTCP.definition: Capital contributed by partners in a partnership business.

BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.name: SHARE PREMIUM
BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.definition: Amount received from shareholders in excess of the par value of shares issued.
BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.exclusions: Do not infer premium from ordinary cash receipts; require review.
BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.purpose: Share premium where applicable under entity policy

BS/EQ/CPR/RVSP.name: REVALUATION SURPLUS
BS/EQ/CPR/RVSP.definition: Reserve created when an asset is revalued upwards, reﬂecting unrealized gain.
BS/EQ/CPR/RVSP.exclusions: Exclude sale proceeds and ordinary revenue.

BS/EQ/RVR/APNL.name: ACCUMULATED PROFIT AND LOSS
BS/EQ/RVR/APNL.definition: Cumulative net proﬁts or losses retained in the business, not distributed as dividends.
BS/EQ/RVR/APNL.exclusions: Exclude ordinary invoice revenue or expenses.

BS/NL/NBR/NCTL.name: LONG TERM LOAN
BS/NL/NBR/NCTL.definition: Borrowings from banks or ﬁnancial institutions with a repayment term exceeding one year.
BS/NL/NBR/NCTL.purpose: Bank borrowing payable beyond twelve months

BS/NL/NFL/NCFL.name: LONG TERM FINANCE LEASE
BS/NL/NFL/NCFL.definition: Lease obligations for assets under ﬁnance leases with terms longer than one year.
BS/NL/NFL/NCFL.exclusions: Exclude lease interest; apply approved lease policy.

BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.name: LONG TERM DEFERRED TAX
BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.definition: Tax liabilities expected to be settled in future periods beyond one year, arising from temporary differences.
BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.exclusions: Exclude current income tax payable; require review.
BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.purpose: Future tax obligations from temporary differences

BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.name: TRADE CREDITORS
BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.definition: Amounts owed to suppliers for goods or services purchased on credit in the normal course of business.
BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.exclusions: Exclude customer advances and non-trade creditors.
BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.purpose: Supplier balances due for ordinary credit purchases

BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.name: TRADE DEPOSIT RECEIVABLES
BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.definition: Deposits received from customers as advance payments or security against future orders.
BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.exclusions: Exclude supplier deposits paid; not earned revenue automatically.
BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.purpose: Deposits received against future customer orders

BS/CL/OPY/OPCR.name: OTHER CREDITORS
BS/CL/OPY/OPCR.definition: Short-term payables to third parties not related to trade purchases (e.g., service providers, contractors).
usage_examples: Non-trade amount owed to third party
BS/CL/OPY/OPCR.exclusions: Exclude ordinary trade suppliers and accrued uninvoiced expenses.

BS/CL/OPY/OPDC.name: DIRECTOR ACCOUNT (CREDITORS)
BS/CL/OPY/OPDC.definition: Amounts owed to company directors for loans, advances, or other transactions.
BS/CL/OPY/OPDC.exclusions: Exclude director receivables and equity contributions.

BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.name: ACCRUAL
BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.definition: Expenses incurred but not yet paid or invoiced at the reporting date.
usage_examples: Unbilled electricity consumed at month end
BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.exclusions: Exclude future service prepayments and already booked invoices.
BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.purpose: Expenses incurred but not yet paid or invoiced at reporting date

BS/CL/SFL/STFL.name: SHORT TERM FINANCE LEASE
BS/CL/SFL/STFL.definition: Current portion of obligations under ﬁnance leases due within one year.
BS/CL/SFL/STFL.purpose: Lease principal due within twelve months

BS/CL/CTL/CRTX.name: CURRENT TAX PAYABLE
BS/CL/CTL/CRTX.definition: Tax liabilities due for payment within the current ﬁnancial year.
BS/CL/CTL/CRTX.exclusions: Use SNTP for sales and service tax, not income tax.

BS/CL/CTL/STDF.name: SERVICE TAX DEFERRED
BS/CL/CTL/STDF.definition: Collected service tax not yet remitted to authorities.
BS/CL/CTL/STDF.exclusions: Do not infer tax timing or rates; require review.
BS/CL/CTL/STDF.purpose: Deferred service tax balance under applicable policy

BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.name: SALES AND SERVICE TAX PAYABLES
BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.definition: Outstanding sales tax and service tax payable to tax authorities.
BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.exclusions: Exclude income tax and tax charged by suppliers as an automatically recoverable asset.
BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.purpose: Explicit sales and service tax owed to authorities

BS/CL/SBR/TRFL.name: TRADE FINANCE LOAN
BS/CL/SBR/TRFL.definition: Short-term loans used to ﬁnance trade activities like inventory purchase.

BS/CL/SBR/OVDF.name: OVERDRAFT
BS/CL/SBR/OVDF.definition: Short-term borrowing facility allowing withdrawal beyond account balance.
BS/CL/SBR/OVDF.exclusions: Exclude ordinary positive bank balance and overdraft interest.

BS/CL/SBR/SHTL.name: SHORT TERM LOAN
BS/CL/SBR/SHTL.definition: Borrowings from banks repayable within one year.

PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.name: SALES INCOME
PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.definition: Revenue earned from the sale of goods.
PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.exclusions: Exclude customer advance before goods are delivered.
PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.purpose: Earned operating revenue from goods sold

PL/TI/TIN/SVIC.name: SERVICE INCOME
PL/TI/TIN/SVIC.exclusions: Exclude unearned advance for future services.
PL/TI/TIN/SVIC.purpose: Earned operating revenue from services supplied

PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.name: COST OF SALES
PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.definition: Direct costs attributable to the production of goods sold.
PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.exclusions: Exclude unsold inventory and general administrative costs.
PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.purpose: Direct costs attributable to goods or services sold

PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.name: DISTRIBUTION EXPENSES
PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.definition: Costs related to storing, handling, and delivering goods to customers.
PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.exclusions: Distinguish inventory acquisition costs and marketing.
PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.purpose: Storage, handling and delivery costs for customers

PL/TE/TEX/MKEX.name: MARKETING EXPENSES
PL/TE/TEX/MKEX.definition: Expenses incurred for advertising, promotions, and brand activities.
PL/TE/TEX/MKEX.exclusions: Exclude equipment assets and refundable campaign deposits.

PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.name: OTHER OPERATING EXPENSES
PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.definition: Miscellaneous operational costs not classiﬁed elsewhere.
PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.exclusions: Exclude administration, finance, inventory, assets and unconsumed prepaid coverage.
PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.purpose: Other costs of primary business operations

PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.name: DISBURSEMENT
PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.definition: Income received from reimbursements of expenses paid on behalf of others.
PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.exclusions: May be clearing a receivable rather than income; require evidence and review.
PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.purpose: Disbursement recoveries when policy recognises income

PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.name: REIMBURSEMENT
PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.definition: Repayment of previously incurred expenses by a third party.
PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.exclusions: May offset expense or receivable; do not recognise income automatically.
PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.purpose: Reimbursement of prior costs when income treatment applies

PL/OI/OIN/OVTC.name: OVERDUE INTEREST INCOME
PL/OI/OIN/OVTC.definition: Interest earned on overdue payments from debtors or late settlements.
PL/OI/OIN/OVTC.purpose: Interest earned on late customer payments

PL/OI/OIN/BINC.name: BANK INTEREST INCOME
PL/OI/OIN/BINC.definition: Interest income earned from bank deposits or savings accounts.
PL/OI/OIN/BINC.exclusions: Exclude interest paid and loan principal.

PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.name: REBATE / DISCOUNT RECEIVED
PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.definition: Cashbacks, volume rebates, or discounts received from suppliers.
PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.exclusions: May reduce inventory or purchase cost; follow company policy.
PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.purpose: Supplier rebates where income classification applies

PL/OI/OIN/GPME.name: GAIN ON DISPOSAL OF PLANT, MACHINE AND EQUIPMENT
PL/OI/OIN/GPME.definition: Proﬁt earned from selling ﬁxed assets above their book value.
PL/OI/OIN/GPME.exclusions: Sale proceeds alone are insufficient; carrying value is needed.
PL/OI/OIN/GPME.purpose: Gain above carrying value on fixed asset disposal

PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.name: RENTAL INCOME
PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.definition: Income earned from leasing out property or equipment.
PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.exclusions: Primary rental business may need operating service income; assess MSIC and actual use.
PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.purpose: Incidental rental income outside primary operations

PL/OI/OIN/ISCL.name: INSURANCE CLAIM
PL/OI/OIN/ISCL.definition: Compensation received from insurance companies for covered losses.
PL/OI/OIN/ISCL.exclusions: Exclude insurance premiums and prepaid insurance.

PL/OI/OIN/BDRC.name: BAD DEBTS RECOVERED
PL/OI/OIN/BDRC.definition: Amounts previously written off as bad debts that are later collected.

PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.name: OTHER INCOME
PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.definition: Miscellaneous income not classiﬁed under other speciﬁed categories.
PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.exclusions: Prefer specific category where evidence supports it.
PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.purpose: Incidental income not fitting specific categories

PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.name: DEPRECIATION
PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.definition: Systematic allocation of the cost of tangible ﬁxed assets over their useful lives.
PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.exclusions: Exclude initial asset purchase and tax capital allowances.
PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.purpose: Allocation of capital asset cost over useful life

PL/OE/OEX/GNEX.name: GENERAL EXPENSES
PL/OE/OEX/GNEX.definition: Day-to-day administrative costs such as utilities, oﬃce supplies, and insurance.
PL/OE/OEX/GNEX.exclusions: Exclude future prepaid coverage, capital assets and direct cost of sales.

PL/FE/FEX/OVNT.name: OVERDRAFT INTEREST
PL/FE/FEX/OVNT.definition: Interest charged on overdrawn bank accounts.
PL/FE/FEX/OVNT.exclusions: Exclude principal and ordinary bank service fees.

PL/FE/FEX/FLNT.name: FINANCE LEASE INTEREST
PL/FE/FEX/FLNT.definition: Interest expense incurred on ﬁnance lease liabilities.
PL/FE/FEX/FLNT.purpose: Interest component of finance lease payment

PL/FE/FEX/TLNT.name: TERM LOAN INTEREST
PL/FE/FEX/TLNT.definition: Interest paid on long-term or short-term bank loans.
PL/FE/FEX/TLNT.exclusions: Exclude principal and qualifying capitalised borrowing costs.

PL/FE/FEX/OVNX.name: OVERDUE INTEREST EXPENSES
PL/FE/FEX/OVNX.definition: Interest incurred on overdue payments to suppliers or creditors.

PL/FE/FEX/TDFT.name: TRADE FINANCE INTEREST
PL/FE/FEX/TDFT.definition: Interest paid on trade ﬁnance facilities such as letters of credit.

PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.name: OTHER INTEREST
PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.definition: Miscellaneous interest expenses not classiﬁed elsewhere.
PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.exclusions: Exclude non-interest bank charges; PDF examples conflict, use nature of charge.
PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.purpose: Other financing interest not classified above

PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.name: CURRENT YEAR TAX
PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.definition: Income tax expense payable for the current ﬁnancial year.
PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.exclusions: Exclude tax instalment assets and SST.
PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.purpose: Income tax expense on current-year profits

PL/TX/ITX/TXPL.name: TAX PENALTIES
PL/TX/ITX/TXPL.definition: Fines or penalties imposed by tax authorities for late payment or non-compliance.
PL/TX/ITX/TXPL.exclusions: Exclude ordinary tax principal; do not infer deductibility.

PL/TX/ITX/TDTX.name: DEFERRED TAX
PL/TX/ITX/TDTX.definition: Tax effects arising from temporary differences between accounting and tax values.
PL/TX/ITX/TDTX.exclusions: Exclude current tax payment; requires review.

PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.name: PROPERTY GAIN TAX
PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.definition: Tax levied on proﬁts from the sale or transfer of real property.
PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.exclusions: Exclude disposal proceeds and other income tax.
PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.purpose: Tax expense on taxable property disposal

PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.name: CAPITAL GAIN TAX
PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.definition: Tax on gains from the disposal of capital assets, such as investments or property.
PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.exclusions: Do not infer tax liability from sale alone.
PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.purpose: Tax expense on relevant capital asset gains

PL/TX/OTX/OTEX.name: OTHER TAX EXPENSES
PL/TX/OTX/OTEX.definition: Miscellaneous tax-related expenses not classiﬁed under speciﬁc tax types.
PL/TX/OTX/OTEX.purpose: Other tax costs not classified above
